lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn3FeN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—Mn6Fe2N2—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers coordinated by 3 N neighbors and N centers coordinated by 10 Mn neighbors, while Mn adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors (3 Fe and 9 Mn). Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mn–Mn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and N–N 10-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and faces, forming a 3-dimensional connected network.
